title.value: File a complex tax return with OpenClaw

introduction.value: OpenClaw built a Schedule C P&L from bank transactions, guided TurboTax entry for 4+ hours and caught an error in a prior accountant's work.

method.value: User uploaded purchase agreements, K-1s, prior returns back to 2012, bank statements, and balance sheets to OpenClaw. The agent read them chronologically, reconstructed entity history and cost basis across LLC-to-S-corp conversions and sales, prepared a summary.md, built Schedule C P&L from bank transactions, researched TurboTax plans, and dictated entries screen-by-screen while the user clicked through forms and recategorized one transaction.

outcome.value: Produced a 137-page return with $125K federal due after $40K estimated payments already made; saved $500 on the TurboTax plan and ~$3,700 via annualized income method on Form 2210. Browser automation failed so user drove TurboTax; K-1 had to be estimated.

notes.value: Total cost was $129 TurboTax + $23.90 in tokens versus $8,000 CPA the prior year.

source_text.body:
File a complex tax return with OpenClaw
OpenClaw built a Schedule C P&L from bank transactions, guided TurboTax entry for 4+ hours and caught an error in a prior accountant's work.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
User uploaded purchase agreements, K-1s, prior returns back to 2012, bank statements, and balance sheets to OpenClaw. The agent read them chronologically, reconstructed entity history and cost basis across LLC-to-S-corp conversions and sales, prepared a summary.md, built Schedule C P&L from bank transactions, researched TurboTax plans, and dictated entries screen-by-screen while the user clicked through forms and recategorized one transaction.
How it went
Produced a 137-page return with $125K federal due after $40K estimated payments already made; saved $500 on the TurboTax plan and ~$3,700 via annualized income method on Form 2210. Browser automation failed so user drove TurboTax; K-1 had to be estimated.
Worth knowing
Total cost was $129 TurboTax + $23.90 in tokens versus $8,000 CPA the prior year.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Using my bank transaction exports in [folder or account], build a Schedule C profit and loss for [year] for my business [business type]. Sort expenses into the right categories, list anything ambiguous for me to decide, and double-check last year's return at [file path] for inconsistencies. Then guide me through entering it in [tax software], and pause before anything is filed or submitted.
Original source: https://x.com/dvassallo/status/2039450517143974105
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: An OpenClaw user describes preparing a complicated personal and business tax return.
introduction.zh: 一位 OpenClaw 用户描述了复杂个人与经营税表的准备过程。

method.en: OpenClaw received purchase agreements, K-1s, returns back to 2012, bank statements and balance sheets. It reconstructed entity changes, sales and cost basis in chronological order.
method.zh: OpenClaw读取购置协议、K-1、追溯至2012年的税表、账单和资产负债表，按时间重建实体变更、出售及成本基础。

method.en: It produced summary.md and a Schedule C profit-and-loss calculation, compared TurboTax plans and guided entries for over four hours. The user clicked the forms and corrected a transaction after browser automation failed.
method.zh: 它生成summary.md与Schedule C损益计算，比较TurboTax套餐并指导录入超过四小时；浏览器自动化失败后，用户自行点表单并纠正一项交易。

outcome.en: The account reports a 137-page return, $125,000 federal tax still due after $40,000 estimated payments, a $500 software-plan saving and about $3,700 through Form 2210’s annualized-income approach.
outcome.zh: 叙述报告137页税表，已付4万美元预估税后仍有12.5万美元联邦应付额；另称软件套餐省500美元，Form 2210年化收入方法省约3,700美元。

notes.en: A K-1 was estimated. Reported spending was $129 for TurboTax plus $23.90 in tokens, compared with an $8,000 prior-year CPA bill; differing years and work scope prevent a clean price comparison.
notes.zh: 其中一份K-1使用估算；报告费用为TurboTax 129美元及token 23.90美元，对比上年8,000美元CPA账单，但年度及服务范围不同，不能直接等价比较。
